description: The Brisk Teaching connector brings your classroom toolkit into ChatGPT. Create interactive student activities, engaging podcasts, and more right in the tools you already use. Just describe what you need, and Brisk builds it in your account with easy-to-share links, so you can turn your ideas into classroom-ready materials in seconds. Edit, refine, and bring them to your students whenever you're ready.
